jobs.title: (Senior) Supply Chain Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
About the role

Every RELEX implementation is a solution built from scratch for one customer: their processes, their data, their targets. (Senior) Supply Chain Consultants shape both sides of that build — the business processes and KPIs the customer will run on, and the configuration that makes them work in the system. Depending on your background you will lean more towards one side than the other. This is a heavily customer-facing role.

What you'll be doing

  • Understand how the customer really plans. Prepare, facilitate and document workshops to gather and specify business requirements, and run the data analysis that shows where the strengths and the gaps actually are.
  • Design the target picture — planning processes, roles and the KPIs the project is measured on — and guide customers towards RELEX best practice, including where their current way of working needs to change.
  • Build it. Configuration, business rules, workflows and reporting that deliver the design you just agreed, and that hold up in operation: nightly run performance, scalability and maintainability, not just functional correctness.
  • Make the value case tangible for customer leadership: define how forecast accuracy, availability, inventory and cost will be measured, and report honestly on where we stand.
  • Take it live. Coordinate User Acceptance Testing, resolve what testing surfaces, and upskill super users so the customer is proficient and self-sustaining after go-live.
  • Own adoption, not just delivery. A technically correct solution that nobody uses is not a successful project.
  • Document what you built — requirements, scope and configuration — so the project team, the customer and our Continuous Services colleagues can work with it after handover.
  • Work across disciplines: with Technical Consultants on the data model, interfaces and the customer's ERP landscape, and with Project Managers on scope, effort and timelines.

Within RELEX

  • Challenge and develop implementation best practice across industries (grocery, DIY, home goods, pharma, wholesale and more)
  • Share knowledge with the team as both a trainer and a participant, and support colleagues who are earlier in their journey
  • Work with our global teams on international projects and bring practices between regions
  • Use AI tooling actively in your daily work — we expect curiosity here and give you room to experiment

What we're looking for

  • Around 2+ years of

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

Position Summary

The Senior Sales Engineer lives and works in the intersection between sales and engineering. The ideal candidate must be able to articulate technology and product positioning at the executive, business and technical levels. Sales Engineers are the primary technical support for the sales force and are responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process. They are there to ensure success with all Harness customers and strategize with their sales counterparts to steer customers to a commercial relationship.

jobs.title: Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement
jobs.description:
Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement

Location: Remote — this is a remote, work-from-home role, as are all positions at Acceleration Partners. Some travel is required for client meetings, internal meetings, conferences, and industry events.

The Role

The Associate Director / Director, Data Strategy & Measurement is responsible for defining and leading Acceleration Partners' data, analytics and measurement capability. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, data science, measurement, AI-enabled insights and commercial growth. The Director will work directly with enterprise clients to understand their marketing and business data ecosystem, develop measurement strategies, and help clients make better decisions through data. Internally, the role will partner with Client Services, Strategy, Sales and AI Automation teams to build AP's data capability, improve decision-making, develop new services and products, and raise data literacy across the organization. As a senior leader, the Director will also develop AP's market position as a leading authority on affiliate, influencer and partnership measurement.

Top Responsibilities:

Client Measurement & Data Strategy

• Serve as AP's senior advisor on measurement, analytics and reporting.

• Understand client data ecosystems including affiliate networks, influencer platforms, Google Analytics, CRM systems, customer databases, MMM outputs and business intelligence tools.

• Design measurement frameworks that connect partnership marketing activity to broader business outcomes, spanning attribution, incrementality, customer acquisition and lifetime value.

• Advise clients on how affiliate and influencer activity should be measured alongside paid media, brand marketing and broader customer acquisition strategies.

• Own AP's point of view on measurement, partnering with MMM providers, analytics platforms and measurement vendors to keep AP at the forefront of measurement innovation.

Strategic Consulting & Problem Solving

• Lead analytical workstreams for enterprise clients, including programme audits and strategic reviews.

• Support growth strategies, forecasting, partner valuation models and opportunity assessments.

• Translate complex datasets into actionable commercial recommendations.

• Partner with senior client stakeholders across Marketing, Analytics, Finance and Data Science teams.

Data Products & Capability Development • Define and own AP's data and analytics roadmap.

• Partner with Strategy and AI teams to identify opportunities for automation and AI-enabled insights.

• Lead development of scalable reporting frameworks, dashboards, benchmarking products and measurement tools.

• Drive innovation across APVision

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Compute Libraries
jobs.description:
About the job

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll develop, maintain and release the C++ libraries and runtime APIs that engineers use to build and execute workloads on Graphcore’s AI hardware.
Your work will focus on developer-facing libraries, runtime components or a combination of both. You’ll design clear abstractions for low-level hardware capabilities, improve reliability and performance, and support developers integrating these libraries into the wider software stack.

You will take ownership of library changes from design and implementation through review, integration, release and ongoing maintenance. Deliver dependable library releases through packaging, dependency validation, release notes and the maintenance fixes developers need.

You’ll write API documentation, usage examples and migration guidance to help developers adopt changes confidently. Work with library users across the software stack to understand requirements, resolve integration issues and guide API improvements.

The team and culture

The AI Compute Libraries team develops high-performance compute libraries and the software infrastructure that helps engineers make effective use of Graphcore’s AI hardware.

You’ll work alongside specialists in accelerator software, runtime systems and performance engineering. Together, you’ll turn hardware capabilities and developer requirements into practical, well-tested APIs, with clear documentation and dependable releases.

What we’re looking for

Essential skills:

  • Strong modern C++ skills and a commitment to producing reliable, maintainable code.
  • The ability to turn complex, low-level concepts into clear APIs and abstractions.
  • Strong debugging and automated testing skills, including diagnosing issues in existing codebases.
  • Confidence owning substantial engineering tasks independently and working effectively across teams.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience with hardware accelerators, heterogeneous computing or architecture-specific software.
  • Experience with embedded DSLs, graph representations, descriptor generation or compiler infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with CMake, C++ library packaging, API/ABI compatibility, versioning or dependency management.
  • Experience integrating C++ libraries with Python or ML frameworks such as PyTorch.
  • Experience improving release automation, compatibility testing or developer tooling.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning

jobs.title: Principal Radio Frequency Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Electromagnetic and Cyber Group (EM&C) is responsible for developing flexible and survivable advanced electronic warfare and secure communications equipment while providing the industry’s leading signals intelligence, electronic warfare, and cyber experts.  Metrea specialises in signal classification, direction finding, advanced geolocation techniques, and waveform development including waveforms for MANET and LPI/LPD applications. Metrea also develops special purpose radios for government customers and licenses DF and geolocation solutions to multiple OEMs.

The Expeditionary Operations Lab, or EXOLAB, focuses on the rapid development, integration, evaluation and delivery of expeditionary capabilities within the Electromagnetic Warfare and Cyber domain. EXOLAB works across research and development, experimentation, prototyping, systems integration, trials

jobs.title: Quantum Algorithms Researcher (Senior/Staff)
jobs.description:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.  We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.  Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.  We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Germany is one of Europe's largest healthcare markets, and its hospitals face the same pressure we solve in France: rising administrative load, staff shortages and revenue lost to incomplete coding. jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.  Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Collaborate across RF, controls, electronics, and systems teams to define system interfaces, ICDs, and verification plans.

Degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

Strong proficiency in HDL (VHDL, Verilog, SystemVerilog) and software scripting (Python, C/C++).

Proven experience integrating FPGAs with hardware peripherals, board-level electronics, and communication interfaces.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
jobs.description:
Founding Engineer

Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices.

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.  Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.  Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is  not  what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on.

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.  You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

We’re the layer between the home and the grid. Our  platform  connects every asset, coordinates every home and shapes thousands as one.  Asset connectivity  gives energy retailers one API for 1,000+ device models across 100+ brands.  Home energy coordination  turns that connection into smarter behavior at home, like charging an EV in the cheapest hours or using more of your own solar.  Residential flexibility  brings connected homes together into a dispatchable resource the grid can count on.

Europe’s largest energy companies build on  Enode : retailers, utilities and the teams that trade for them. The platform spans 1.7M+ connected households and 5,000+ MW of controllable load. We’re backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the next grid gets built. We’re looking for people who take ownership, think clearly under complexity and care deeply about the craft of building software that matters.

We assess this in our interview process, alongside everything else we look at.

The design team at Enode ships. We’re looking for a Senior Design Engineer who’s as comfortable in a codebase as they are in Figma, and who closes the gap between the two.

You’ll build the interfaces energy retailers and their developers use: the Enode Platform, where they integrate and debug; Link UI, the flow their customers go through when they connect a car or a heat pump; and the website that tells our story. You’ll turn designs into production-ready code, prototype ideas before they become designs, and help look after the design system that keeps all of it consistent.

You’ll report to Daniël, our Head of Design, and join a small, senior design team that works across product and brand. You’ll have real ownership: what you build goes live.

Day to day, each designer works mostly with their own team of engineers, often alongside a product manager. Every Monday, the designers get together to sync and share their work. We team up on projects when it makes sense, and jump on a quick huddle whenever someone wants feedback.

jobs.title: Social Media Manager (TikTok Specialist)
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Social Media Manager (TikTok Specialist) to join our Pokémon GO! Team in Mexico City on a hybrid basis, working 3 days a week from the hub.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What You Will Do

We’re looking for someone who is highly creative, quick-witted, and excited to experiment. You should be overflowing with social and short-form video ideas, comfortable moving quickly from concept to execution, and confident identifying cultural moments that Pokémon GO can authentically join.This is also a hands-on, on-camera role. You should feel comfortable and confident appearing in videos across Pokémon GO’s official social channels and be excited to help give the brand a relatable, engaging presence.

The ideal candidate is energized by interacting with players, not simply responsible for it. You’ll engage directly with the Pokémon GO community, develop content that speaks to regional and global audiences, and translate trends into ideas that feel unmistakably Pokémon GO.

You’ll need to be a strong self-starter who can manage a full workload, shift quickly between projects, and build and leverage AI tools and workflows to assist you in your day-to-day projects. If you’re a short-form video expert who can generate a steady stream of executable ideas and bring those ideas to life quickly—we want to hear from you.

  • Support the day-to-day planning and execution of content across Pokémon GO’s official social media channels, including copywriting, publishing, community engagement, performance tracking, and contributing to an energetic, authentic brand voice
  • Generate a consistent pipeline of creative, timely, and executable social content ideas, with a strong emphasis on short-form video. Identify promising video formats, trends, hooks, and cultural moments, then translate them into content that feels authentic to Pokémon GO and its community
  • Move quickly from idea to execution by independently developing, producing, and appearing in social video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other emerging platforms while remaining aligned with brand standards
  • Develop campaign, content, and video briefs that clearly communicate creative direction, messaging, format, and cultural relevance
  • Monitor trends and emerging digital behaviors, particularly those influencing Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences
  • Lead player engagement across official Pokémon GO social channels, building meaningful connections with players and contributing an energetic, authentic brand voice.

Scopely is looking for a Sr. Director Business Development to join our Global Publishing team!

The Business Development team is responsible for business negotiations, partner management, and new expansion opportunities with our largest IP partners, new distribution platforms (e.g. storefronts, hardware manufacturers, subscription services, etc.), and digital payment partners (e.g. Stripe, Visa, Checkout.com, etc.) around the world.   • Experience creating and executing a global business development strategy
  • Ability to identify and negotiate large scale commercial agreements
  • Gaming experience preferred, and particularly free-to-play games
  • Passion & love for video games
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changes
  • Ability to analyze data to make data-driven decisions - skills in Excel and Google Sheets necessary

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Performance Marketing Manager, Forecasting & Market Intelligence, to join our Performance Marketing team in Canada on a remote basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day, whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

The Performance Marketing team helps drive sustainable player growth across Scopely’s portfolio. This role will sit at the intersection of performance marketing, forecasting, competitive intelligence, and market research, supporting active and upcoming Slate titles as they move from early planning through testing, soft launch, and global launch.

What You Will Do

You will build the analytical foundation behind UA forecasts and growth plans: identifying the right comparable titles, developing market and geo assumptions, maintaining benchmarks, tracking competitive signals, and turning incomplete information into structured first-pass recommendations. This is a highly analytical role for someone who enjoys working through ambiguity and can challenge, validate, and refine assumptions rather than taking inputs at face value.

  • Develop first-pass performance marketing forecasts and supporting inputs for upcoming Slate titles, including install curves, geo-tier views, channel assumptions, paid and organic assumptions, and launch phasing.
  • Build and maintain relevant comparable game-peer sets based on genre, monetization model, platform, geo mix, audience, launch strategy, creative approach, and expected scale.
  • Develop and maintain dCPI benchmarks and degradation curves, combining Scopely historical performance, partner benchmarks, competitor data, and external market signals.
  • Support organic forecasting by developing assumptions around baseline organic demand, paid-driven lift, launch/IP halo, virality, and organic-to-paid ratios.
  • Build sensitivity analyses that make the impact of key assumptions clear and help teams understand the range of potential outcomes.
  • Track competitor UA investment, creative trends, app-store movement, channel activity, launch performance, and regional signals across relevant games and genres.
  • Produce recurring market-intelligence and competitive-pulse readouts that identify meaningful changes in the market and potential implications for Slate titles.
  • Incorporate learnings from market research, beta acquisition, creative and audience testing, soft launch, and other pre-launch signals into forecast assumptions.
  • Support regional opportunity sizing and geo strategy, including differences in acquisition cost, scale, organic potential, and market dynamics

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

As Design Director, World Systems, you will own the design of procedural world generation — the systems and craft that combine terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, and points of interest into a cohesive, playable world. You will be hands-on from day one, partner closely with Tools to build the frameworks and tuning levers the team needs, and grow your team over time to serve the needs of the project.

What you will do:

  • Own the player experience of generated worlds and raise it to a standard that feels authored, readable, and worth exploring.
  • Define how diverse world elements (terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, POIs) compose into a cohesive whole rather than a pile of systems.
  • Establish and enforce world-design standards for density, gameplay pacing, traversal distances, sightlines, landmarking, and encounter/POI placement.
  • Partner with the Tools team to specify generation frameworks, authoring workflows, and the levers designers use to tune procedural output.
  • Work end-to-end in an iterative process — from earliest world concepts and prototypes through directing designers in implementation and live iteration.
  • Bring a strong level-design sensibility to procedural space: how far players walk, what they see, when the world breathes, and when it demands attention.
  • Follow a design-thinking methodology to understand player needs, ideate, and propose solutions that meet both player and business goals.
  • Understand our audience at a deep, empathetic level, and formulate world solutions that serve different player segments.

Collaborating with both internal and external partners, you’ll support regular feature and content releases, from initial concept through to post-release support, ensuring that the highest quality is maintained throughout.

As a key advocate for quality at Scopely, you will help shape our ongoing commitment to excellence.

  • Ensure your pod’s contributions to each release meet the highest standard of quality, focusing on both defect prevention and overall user experience, while also maintaining a broad, holistic view of release quality across the wider team
  • Develop clear and comprehensive test plans that define scope of coverage, accurate time estimates, resourcing needs, tooling / cheat needs, and any wider requirements to support testing from concept through to release
  • Drive the creation, upkeep, and execution of test suites and cases tailored to your pod’s specific needs and evolving scope
  • Support and adopt AI-driven QA initiatives, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, coverage, and reporting
  • Maintain a clean and prioritized bug database in alignment with your pod’s work
  • Lead the onboarding of external embedded QA resources into your pod, ensuring they are set up for success and aligned with internal processes, while fostering a strong working relationship to remain aligned on priorities at all times
  • Take ownership of your pod’s quality output by leading through example, performing hands-on testing, and ensuring accountability at all stages of development
  • Raise pre-production quality concerns by reviewing briefs and design documents, championing a ‘shift left’ attitude
  • Facilitate pod-specific playtests to gather broader feedback, track issues effectively, and ensure follow-up actions are taken where needed
  • Collaborate with Customer Support and the Live & Release teams to investigate live issues, advocating for timely resolutions while addressing root causes

jobs.title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
jobs.location: ES - Barcelona, Spain; GB - United Kingdom
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.

What You'll Do:

We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.

  • Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.
  • Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change.
  • Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.
  • Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.
  • Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is.
  • Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.
  • Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.
  • Give teams operati

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Riot Client - Publishing Platform
jobs.description:
Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas, but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Software Engineers, we work with both established and emerging technology, creating innovative solutions to overcome high-volume obstacles and to deliver value to our players.

Riot Client is the gateway for millions of players to play, discover, and install Riot games. Your work on the Client will be every single desktop players' first touchpoint with the wide range of experiences that Riot has to offer, including Riot’s culture & community, or getting into any of our games as fast as possible, like League of Legends, Wild Rift, Teamfight Tactics, VALORANT, Legends of Runeterra, 2XKO, and beyond. It is also an essential tool for internal game developers including live games and R&D games. Introduced in 2021, the multi-game Riot Client is becoming a destination for players to engage with Riot games, events and communities, and is a fast-evolving desktop software that provides capabilities in game distribution, content publishing, social and internal development efficiency.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Riot Client team, you will deliver high-quality technical solutions that improve the player experience across Riot’s out-of-game ecosystem. You’ll contribute hands-on across the software development lifecycle, partnering closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional teammates to build reliable, scalable, and maintainable Client capabilities. You will help shape technical direction within your area of ownership, make sound implementation and design decisions, and collaborate with peers across Riot to support game distribution, content, social features, and developer productivity. Through strong engineering practices, thoughtful code reviews, and mentorship of other engineers, your work will help advance the next generation of Riot Client experiences for players and developers.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain desktop application features focusing on C++, with the ability to integrate with and contribute to web-based technologies
  • Deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable engineering solutions within your area of ownership, through hands-on contribution and technical design
  • Contribute to technical planning and design discussions, helping evaluate tradeoffs between long-term sustainability and near-term delivery needs
  • Build and apply a strong understanding of the Riot Client’s dependency landscape, partnering with teams to align on technical solutions
  • Work closely with cross-functional partners, including product, production, QA, design, and data insight
  • Level up other engineers through mentorship and technical guidance

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of related industry experience
  • Bachelor's degree

jobs.title: Senior Security IAM Engineer
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior IAM Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona. This role will focus on building, scaling, and securing Scopely’s identity and access management ecosystem across our cloud, SaaS, AI, and remote access environments, with a strong emphasis on Terraform-based IAM automation, access workflow engineering, least-privilege design, identity risk reduction, and AI-assisted operational workflows.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Build and Evolve Modern IAM Architecture

  • Design and evolve Scopely’s IAM architecture to support a high-scale, cloud-first environment across AWS, GCP, SaaS applications, AI tooling, and remote access platforms.

Lead initiatives around:

  • Federated identity architecture using SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM
  • Workforce identity and access patterns across internal platforms
  • Least-privilege role design and access segmentation
  • RBAC and ABAC models for cloud and SaaS environments
  • Centralized access models using Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Google Cloud IAM, and cloud-native IAM services
  • Secure cross-account and cross-project access patterns
  • Service account, workload identity, and non-human identity governance
  • Zero Trust identity and access control design

Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and security teams to:

  • Standardize secure identity and access patterns
  • Reduce identity sprawl and excessive permissions
  • Improve access visibility and auditability
  • Build scalable identity controls for a fast-moving engineering environment

Own Terraform-Based IAM and Access Automation

  • Own and improve Terraform-based IAM and access automation across Scopely’s cloud and identity environment.

Design, build, and maintain:

  • Reusable Terraform modules for IAM roles, policies, permission sets, group mappings, and access patterns
  • Terraform workflows for Okta app assignments, group-based access, and IAM Identity Center automation
  • Standardized access modules that can be reused safely across teams and environments
  • Policy-as-code patterns for least privilege and permission boundary enforcement
  • Terraform-driven onboarding and offboarding flows for identity-related systems
  • Automation for service account and workload identity provisi

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played PC game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

The AI Efficiency team at Riot Games builds the platforms, tools, and technical foundations that help Rioters safely and effectively use AI to accelerate how we work. As these systems become increasingly important to creative, product, and development workflows across Riot, we need platform engineering that can keep pace with growing scale, complexity, and expectations.

As a Principal Platform Engineer on the AI Efficiency team, you will design, build, and evolve the internal platforms, automation systems, and operational guardrails that make our AI services and developer workflows more scalable, reliable, and easy to use. You will partner closely with software engineers, infrastructure teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve developer experience, platform reliability, deployment safety, observability, and operational excellence across a growing portfolio of AI services, internal tooling, and supporting infrastructure.

You will also help the team evaluate and operationalize a new generation of AI-native engineering workflows, including agent-assisted code review, automated bug triage and remediation, AI-driven performance and security analysis, browser-based UI validation, and other emerging automation patterns that can safely augment human judgment. This role is not only about building better platforms for today, but also about shaping how Riot adopts the next wave of intelligent engineering tooling responsibly and effectively. Current platform-engineering guidance emphasizes product-minded internal platforms, self-service, and golden paths, while modern browser automation tooling now explicitly supports AI-agent workflows and accessibility-focused testing.

You’re right for this role if you enjoy making complex systems easier to use and operate, reducing cognitive load for engineers, building paved roads instead of one-off solutions, and improving reliability through strong platform design. You are energized not only by hard infrastructure and operational problems, but also by the opportunity to responsibly bring new AI-native automation patterns into real engineering workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Product Analyst - Stumble Guys!
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about using data to shape products played by millions of people around the world? Do you enjoy uncovering player insights, designing experiments, and influencing product decisions with data? If so, we'd love to meet you!

We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst to help shape the future of Stumble Guys, one of the world's leading mobile games. You'll join a team of Product Analysts and Analytics Engineers, partnering closely with Product Managers, Game Designers, Data Engineers, and Developers to turn player behavior into actionable insights.

From event instrumentation and data modeling to A/B testing and deep-dive analyses, you'll help answer our most challenging product questions and directly influence the future of the game.

If you're excited about working on a game played by millions of daily active users (just ask your younger cousins - they're probably already playing!), we'd love to hear from you!

We also work with a modern analytics stack including Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker and Hex.

What You Will Do

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to understand the behavior of millions of players and answer strategic product questions.
  • Partner closely with Product, Game Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Leadership to drive data-informed decisions.
  • Design, analyze, and communicate A/B tests to evaluate new features and optimize player experiences.
  • Develop frameworks, dashboards, and analytical tools that empower teams to make better product decisions.
  • Generate actionable insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and overall game performance.
  • Define and validate event tracking to ensure high-quality product analytics.
  • Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and leadership

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience working as a Product Analyst, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or other consumer digital products.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large-scale datasets.
  • Experience with experimentation (A/B testing), product analytics, and statistical analysis.
  • Intellectual curiosity with a passion for solving complex business problems through data.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills—you can translate complex analyses into clear recommendations.
  • Python or R experience is a plus.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Poké

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Software
jobs.description:
The Security Team of Scopely Explore (formerly known as Niantic) seeks a Senior Security Engineer to improve the security posture of our software development lifecycle, applications, and build infrastructure.

Scopely Explore, known for global hits like Pokémon GO, Monster Hunter Now, and Pikmin Bloom is now part of Scopely, home to games like Monopoly GO!, Stumble Guys, and Star Trek Fleet Command. Together, we engage billions of players worldwide, and we need your expertise to keep them safe!

Do you want to help secure one of the most widely used gaming platforms on the planet? We seek creative and dedicated engineers with excellent technical judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and an eagerness to embrace new technologies.

What You’ll Do

  • Implement and maintain agentic or AI-enabled workflows to speed-up common security tasks.
  • Perform security reviews and audits of platform and application software throughout design and launch.
  • Provide guidance and expertise to product and operations teams across Scopely.
  • Design, build and maintain automation and tooling that amplify the Security Team’s impact and improve the developer experience.
  • Drive initiatives in security architecture, application scanning, fuzzing, and other proactive defenses.
  • Contribute to hardening efforts across in-house libraries, CI/CD systems, and cloud/container environments.
  • Be responsible for third-party library reviews and manage vulnerability remediation.
  • Educate engineers on secure coding practices and help standardize security across teams.
  • Engage in red-team exercises and coordinate with internal teams and external pentesting partners.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors in Computer Science or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in a global company with cloud-centric infrastructure (preferably GCP).
  • You have implemented services and applications with the help of AI tools like Claude, Codex, OpenCode or Gemini and are adept in the use of these tools and adjacent technologies (RAG, MCP, etc).
  • You are capable of creating automation, agentic workflows and tooling to reliably solve problems that scale to the whole enterprise.
  • You have in-depth experience in hardening distributed web services, cloud services and platform architectures.
  • You can demonstrate strong programming skills (preferably Go or Java) and a deep understanding of common vulnerability classes and exploitation patterns across modern stacks.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating across distributed teams.

Bonus Points...

  • Have participated in red-team operations or managed mitigation tracking.

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering, Core Services - VALORANT
jobs.description:
Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in many broader domains. As an Engineering Manager, you will gain organizational alignment by building a strong engineering vision and offering creative solutions to organizational design. You’ll also serve as a mentor for a team of engineers, overseeing performance management, growth opportunities, and accountability.

VALORANT is Riot's take on a character-based tactical shooter (for more info on VALORANT click here!). As a Manager, Software Engineering (Services) in VALORANT’s Core Services team, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the core game services that power VALORANT, a global live-service game with millions of daily active Players. You will lead development of new services, drive evergreen improvements to existing services, improve standards and frameworks to improve services development across VALORANT, and improve the tools and pipelines used to load test, ship, and operate those services. You will work closely with technical teams in Tencent to improve services delivery and operations in China, closing divergences in developer experience and platform behavior between Tencent and Riot regions. You will report to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering (Platform Engineering) for the VALORANT Foundations area.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of 5-10 Software Engineers across experience levels.
  • Ensure VALORANT Players receive a consistently great services experience in Riot and Tencent regions.
  • Serve as a hands-on engineering leader, comfortable contributing across all phases of the product lifecycle, including implementation.
  • Develop a technical vision for your team, working with production and product partners to ensure consistency with overall product goals. Communicate this vision to your team clearly.
  • Advocate for Players, your team, and internal development customers when deciding what to build and why. Coordinate with other teams across Riot and Tencent working on Services technology.
  • Ensure high technical quality of what your team produces. Establish mechanisms to ensure your engineers have room to invent while maintaining a technical backstop for them.
  • Foster a collaborative, challenging, and satisfying environment for your development team. Find and surface issues, opportunities, and address them head-on. Celebrate wins.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team to grow in their roles, develop technical skills, and improve their effectiveness.
  • Champion and model Riot’s values, setting the tone for your team and peers.
  • Participate in your team’s on-call rotation.

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years professional experience as a software engineer working in services development roles.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and aim to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating within the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

The Performance Marketing team is focused on driving player growth and efficiency across a diverse set of digital marketing channels. With teams across the US and Europe, we operate in a fast-evolving mobile advertising ecosystem. In this role, you will play a critical part in launching and scaling our next major title, shaping the future of user acquisition at Scopely.

What You’ll Do

You will lead performance marketing efforts for a new, unannounced ARPG title based on a major IP, driving global user growth and building scalable acquisition strategies from pre-launch through live operations. You will also build and operate Scopely’s first UA pod in China. This role partners closely with Product, Finance, Analytics, Growth Marketing, Creative, and Data Engineering, and sits within Scopely’s Performance Marketing organization.

  • Own and lead global go-to-market Performance Marketing strategy and execution for the new title, from pre-launch testing through global scale
  • Define and execute user acquisition strategies, methodologies, and processes to achieve aggressive growth and efficiency targets
  • Partner with Product, Strategic Marketing, and Growth teams to align UA strategy with game positioning, audience targeting, and lifecycle marketing

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to enhance creative strategy, marketing tech stack, automation, and fraud prevention systems
  • Champion a culture of experimentation—testing new channels, formats, and bidding strategies to unlock incremental growth opportunities
    Manage and optimize multi-million dollar marketing budgets with a focus on ROI and long-term player value

jobs.description:

In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Game Designer, you will design, tweak, and optimize the player experience. Your analytical skills, player insight, and creativity help craft in- and out-of-game experiences that engage and surprise players. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and work with every tool at hand to create and iterate player-focused designs that will delight millions around the world.

You will partner with designers, artists, and engineers to develop, iterate, and improve systems through rapid prototyping, testing, and cross-functional collaboration. This role requires a hands-on designer who is comfortable working in an evolving development environment, balancing experimentation with thoughtful decision-making while continuously improving gameplay systems and player experiences. You will report into the Game Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and improve gameplay systems that deliver engaging player experiences.
  • Develop multiple system design solutions and clearly communicate implementation trade-offs and associated risks.
  • Establish design principles and best practices for future systems design work.
  • Lead small cross-functional teams to develop gameplay systems aligned with product objectives.
  • Create clear design documentation that can be understood and implemented across disciplines.
  • Collaborate closely with designers, artists, engineers, and production partners to create cohesive player experiences.
  • Utilize prototyping, playtesting, and data-informed iteration to validate and improve system designs.
  • Incorporate feedback and continuously refine systems to achieve high-quality player experiences.

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.  Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. A little about us

incident.io  is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.  The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.  We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Being a Cloud Security Engineer at incident means being the person who keeps the one thing customers rely on when their systems are on fire both up and safe, turning “is this secure?” into “yes, and here’s the proof.”

What that looks like day to day

As a Cloud Security Engineer at incident, you own the security of the cloud infrastructure that runs our platform: how it’s built, hardened, monitored and defended. It’s a genuinely varied role. One day you’re tightening IAM across our Google Cloud projects, the next you’re building a Terraform guardrail so engineers get a safe path instead of a ticket, the next you’re leading an investigation into something odd in the audit logs.  You’ll own cloud posture and hardening across GCP and GKE, identity and access, security as code in our Terraform and CI/CD pipelines, detection and response, isolation of customer data in our multi-tenant platform, and the cloud-side controls around our AI features.  We formed our security team this year and there are three of us. We’re hiring a Cloud Security Engineer to give the team real depth in cloud, which means little process, no approval chains, and your fingerprints on everything. We say yes wherever we genuinely can, and you’ll have the authority to block a release when it matters.  We run on Google Cloud and AWS, with Kubernetes, Terraform, Go, Postgres and TypeScript/React. We lean on Claude and other LLMs to move faster.

Who you are

You’ve got deep, hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on Google Cloud. Strong AWS or Azure depth that transfers is fine.

You design least-privilege IAM properly, and you’ve secured Kubernetes or container platforms in production.

You write code to fix problems, not just report them. Terraform is second nature.

You’ve built cloud detection or investigated cloud incidents, and you enjoy following the thread until you find the answer.

You can give hard feedback to an engineer and have them thank you for it.

You’re comfortable with high autonomy. Nobody’s going to hand you a detailed spec, you’re trusted to figure out what needs doing and just do it.

  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑

  • 熟悉风格化角色或变形角色的绑定方案与实现方式
  • 有影视叙事、表演类高规格角色制作流程的相关经验

This is a hands-on role focused on automation, production support, incident response, observability, data integrity, and continuous improvement. You will work with engineering, platform, data, and operations teams to reduce risk, improve efficiency, and protect player experience. Internal Job Title: Systems Engineer II.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate and improve the production infrastructure, cloud services, data platforms, and operational systems that support Wild Rift.
  • Build automation and tooling for deployments, migrations, validation, capacity management, and routine operations.
  • Troubleshoot distributed systems and participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements.
  • Support releases and operational changes while maintaining service continuity and data integrity.
  • Improve monitoring, alerting, dashboards, runbooks, and other operational documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, capacity, and infrastructure cost.
  • Collaborate with global technical partners and provide day-to-day support and guidance to operations teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience, RHCE, RHCSA.
  • 2+ years of industry experience or an advanced degree.
  • Professional experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, site reliability engineering, software engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting production services, preferably in a high-availability or live-service environment.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, networking, cloud infrastructure, storage, compute, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with AWS Cloud and/or Tencent Cloud.
  • Ability to write maintainable automation or production code in Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data-platform concepts, including data movement, replication, validation, and operational integrity.
  • Familiarity with Git-based configuration management, infrastructure as code, or deployment automation.
  • Experience with monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
  • Professional fluency in Mandarin and English, with the ability to work across time zones and technical disciplines.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with distributed data technologies, object storage, Kubernetes, Redis, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-volume online services, game telemetry, or player data.

jobs.title: Staff AI & Data Engineer, HR Systems
jobs.description:
Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential, from secure and compliant systems to efficient business platforms that keep the company running smoothly. HR Tech & Systems builds and evolves the technology ecosystem that supports Rioters across the employee lifecycle.

As a Staff AI & Data Engineer, HR Systems, you will bring deep AI and modern data engineering expertise to HR Systems, accelerating our evolution into an AI-augmented and data-enabled engineering organization. jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Engineering Managers, we gain organisational alignment by building a strong engineering vision and offering creative solutions to organizational design. We also serve as mentors for a team of engineers, overseeing their performance and trying to find stretch opportunities for their growth.

You will partner with engineering and product leaders to identify high-impact technical challenges, set priorities, and guide the delivery of reliable, reusable solutions that support game development across Riot.

jobs.title: Principal, Growth Lead - League of Legends
jobs.description:
We're looking for a strategic, player-obsessed Growth Lead to help grow League of Legends. As a Principal Growth Lead, you'll partner closely with Brand Marketing, Publishing, Product, Lifecycle Marketing, Performance Marketing, and external platform partners to ensure our biggest publishing moments reach our growth audiences in addition to our loyal fans.

Rather than leading the overall campaign strategy, you'll amplify it—ensuring the right audiences receive the right message through the right channels to maximize acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

Success in this role requires equal parts strategic thinking and operational excellence. You'll thrive in ambiguity, develop insights where they don't yet exist, understand the capabilities and limitations of modern marketing technology, and build executable plans that drive measurable business impact. You'll continuously evaluate campaign performance, identify new growth opportunities, and help evolve Riot's publishing capabilities through experimentation and learning.

If you're passionate about combining player understanding, data, marketing technology, and creative execution to solve complex growth challenges, we'd love to have you help shape the future of League of Legends.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Engine & Tools - League of Legends

Riot’s mission is to put players at the center of everything we do. We do this by continuing to evolve and deliver new experiences to players with games like Teamfight Tactics, Legends of Runeterra, VALORANT, and League of Legends: Wild Rift. Riot is also expanding into the world of music/multimedia with the release of our animated series Arcane and music from KDA and True Damage. In short - it’s an exciting time to be a Rioter.

As a Principal Software Engineer in League of Legends, you’ll report to your team’s Engineering Manager in our office in Los Angeles. You will drive the architecture and evolution of League’s core game engine, improving the foundational systems and tools used to develop League. You’ll solve complex technical challenges across these systems, improving their reliability, scalability, and performance while reducing iteration time and workflow friction for developers across League.

  • Provide mentorship to junior and senior engineers across the League team.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to resolve live incidents.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in C++
  • Deep subject matter expertise in building and architecting tools and engine features
  • Experience shipping software at scale that deploys on a range of different platforms
  • Experience collaborating across disciplines (e.g. Design, Art, QA, Production) to create solutions

jobs.title: Principal Insights Analyst - League of Legends
jobs.description:
The Insights discipline helps empower Rioters' decision-making to be more data-informed and put player experience at the forefront. We're an interdisciplinary group of scientists, consultants, and strategists from all sorts of backgrounds who join together to represent and advocate for players around the world. We believe that illuminating the globally diverse experiences, behaviors, and needs of players is critical to Riot living up to our player-focused mission. We're a group united by our love of games, science, and helping others succeed.

As a Principal Insights Analyst on League of Legends, you’ll join the League Insights team – a group of researchers, analysts, ML engineers and data engineers, responsible for solving complex problems and enabling Rioters to make difficult decisions with confidence.

You’ll tackle some of the most complex and ambiguous problems facing League and advise senior leaders on key product and business decisions. This role will have a particular focus on game economy and monetization systems, while also helping evolve how our team conducts analytics work in an increasingly AI-enabled environment. You’ll combine strong product judgment, advanced analytics, and technical expertise to solve difficult problems, build scalable analytical workflows, and mentor analysts across the team.

  • Own and lead some of League’s most complex Insights problem spaces, identifying and prioritizing the right questions, navigating ambiguity, and driving work from problem framing through strategic recommendation.
  • Develop deep analytical perspectives on League’s economy to inform monetization strategy, across questions such as content strategy, spender lifecycle and segmentation, purchasing behavior, product incrementality and cannibalization, and long-term monetization health.
  • Apply advanced analytical methods to uncover the drivers of player behavior and product performance, identify opportunities and risks, and deepen understanding of complex product questions.
  • Develop reusable AI-enabled and agentic analytics workflows, tooling, and reporting approaches that improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of analysis.
  • Help evolve the League Insights analytics ecosystem and standards for an AI-enabled future, including new approaches to interactive reporting, self-service analytics, and AI-assisted analysis.
  • Partner closely with data engineers to align evolving data foundations with downstream analytical workflows, reporting needs, and AI-enabled use cases.
  • Shape product and business decisions through data-driven recommendations and trusted partnership with product teams and League leadership.
  • Serve as a craft leader across Insights, setting quality standards, mentoring senior practitioners, and advancing analytical capabilities across the discipline.

Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. 作为 Unpublished R&D Product 团队的 Senior Game Producer，你将负责建立和完善研发阶段所需的制作管理基础体系，帮助团队在不断变化的工作环境中保持清晰的目标、灵活的执行方式和稳定的协作节奏。

你将制定和维护项目路线图，建立适合团队需求的开发管理流程与协作机制，主动识别潜在风险与依赖关系，并推动团队持续记录、总结和复用工作经验。

你将与团队管理者及不同专业领域的负责人紧密合作，协调跨职能工作，推动关键计划与里程碑落地，并与其他项目管理人员协同解决问题、持续优化团队的工作机制。

此外，你还将指导和培养项目管理团队成员，支持不同专业领域的同事改进工作流程、加强协作，并提升团队整体的执行效率。

你将向团队的 Director, Game Production 汇报工作。

核心职责（Responsibilities）

  • 制定并维护项目制作路线图： 负责为复杂、多阶段的研发项目制定清晰、完整的制作路线图，涵盖开发阶段、关键里程碑及阶段评审节点。将产品目标转化为不同时间维度下切实可行的执行计划，基于经验进行合理评估，并透明地沟通各项目标及里程碑的交付信心与潜在风险。确保团队计划与工作室及 Riot 整体规划保持一致。

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Gameplay - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

We are looking for a gameplay software engineer to join our game development team. In this role, you will work closely with designers and engineers to prototype ideas, implement player-facing features, and help establish scalable development processes and technical foundations.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify, prioritize, and implement gameplay systems and engine features for a new game.
  • Collaborate with product and discipline leads to define focus areas, handoff points, and effective technical solutions for each stage of development.
  • Lead and contribute to architecture, technical design, and implementation for relevant gameplay systems.
  • Help shape the team's technical direction, engineering standards, and development practices.
  • Continuously iterate on solutions to ensure they are robust, scalable, and performant.
  • Mentor other engineers and share best practices across game development disciplines.

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience in the game industry.
  • 4+ years of professional game development experience with Unreal Engine.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience with strong computer science fundamentals.
  • Proficiency with a modern game engine, such as Unreal Engine or Unity.
  • Strong knowledge of common game and software design patterns.
  • Professional experience developing with C++.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience working with both small and mid-sized engineering teams
  • Experience with persistence solutions
  • Leadership experience
  • Experience with agile development

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about the experiences of players, this could be the role for you!

jobs.title: Senior Tools Programmer, UI & AI Workflows
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a senior Tools Programmer to help build the next generation of UI tooling for users and AI-powered agentic workflows (tools that let AI agents assist with and automate UI creation, iteration, and debugging). You'll shape the systems and frameworks that millions of creators rely on, from WYSIWYG editors to the APIs and runtime UI capabilities used to ship games and tools.

In this role, you will

  • Design, build, and integrate AI-powered tools and frameworks for UI authoring, iteration, and debugging
  • Own and evolve the UI tech codebase used to build tools and in-game UI in Unreal Engine
  • Set technical direction for UI tooling and mentor other programmers
  • Collaborate across disciplines to identify improvement areas, gather feedback, and design solutions for developer needs
  • Profile and resolve performance and memory issues in UI systems
  • Work with Epic's internal teams and Unreal Engine licensees to help them solve UI challenges

What we're looking for

  • Strong tools-programming background with experience building tools that improve development workflows in games or other fields
  • Deep expertise in the UI domain (UI frameworks, runtime UI engines, and editor/WYSIWYG tooling)
  • Excellent C++ skills and experience working in a large codebase
  • Some hands-on exposure to AI-powered or agentic workflows, whether through work, courses, or personal projects
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Experience with Unreal Engine is a plus
  • Experience with Slate and/or UMG is a plus
  • Shipped title experience in games or real-time applications is a plus

This role is open to multiple locations in North America (including CA, NYC, & WA).
