Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.  You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As an early Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

    • Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.
    • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[Team 비전]

  • 저희 팀은 특화 모델(Specialized Model) 을 개발합니다. 많은 기업이 반복되는 고정 업무에 frontier 모델 API를 사용하지만, 실제로 필요한 것은 범용 능력의 일부임에도 매 호출마다 범용성 전체에 대한 비용을 지불하게 됩니다. 저희는 오픈소스 파운데이션 모델을 특정 업무에 맞게 빠르게 finetuning하여,
  • 특화 모델 개발 영역에서는 frontier 모델을 기준으로 타겟 업무의 품질·비용 기준을 수립하고, 다양한 규모의 오픈소스 모델을 평가하여 개발에 적합한 모델을 선정합니다. 이후 모델을 타겟 업무에 맞게 고도화하여 frontier 수준의 성능과 높은 비용 효율성을 동시에 달성합니다.
  • 평가 체계 영역에서는 특화 모델의 품질을 신뢰할 수 있게 측정하는 방법론을 설계합니다. Human gold label 기반 정량 지표, LLM-judge 기반 pairwise 비교, 결함 포착률 분석 등 업무 특성에 맞는 평가 프로토콜을 구축하고, 정량 평가와 정성 감사를 결합해 배포 판단의 근거를 만듭니다.
  • 또한 이러한 과정을 자동화된 파이프라인으로 발전시키는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.
  • 새로 합류하시는 분께서는 모델 증류와 finetuning, LLM 평가 등 특화 모델 개발의 전 과정을 함께 추진하며, AI 기술의 실질적인 비즈니스 가치를 만들어가게 됩니다.

  • 특화 모델 개발
    • 고객사 업무 데이터를 기반으로 frontier 모델과 대·소형 오픈소스 모델을 동일 기준으로 실측 평가
    • 모델별 품질·비용 Baseline 구축 및 Teacher/Student 모델 선정

[AI Research 본부 비전]
크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 게임과 비게임 분야를 위한 자체 AI 핵심 기술을 연구 개발하여, 기존 사업의 경쟁력을 강화하는 동시에 AI 기술의 사업화를 지원하며 새로운 가치와 혁신을 창출합니다:

  • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[Culture Fit]
AI Research 본부 인원들은 본인 분야에만 묶여있지 않고 서로 다른 프로젝트 팀원들과 교류 및 협업하여 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시할 수 있습니다. 다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 언어적 장벽을 해소해줄 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.

  • Flow-matching 기반 video/action generator 개발
  • World Model 사전학습 연구: 게임 엔진 데이터(PUBG, 인조이 등)와 실환경 데이터를 함께 활용해 도메인에 종속되지 않는 범용 물리 표현을 학습시키는 방법을 연구하고, pixel-space와 latent-space 표현 방식을 비교·검증
  • Task-aware post-training: 완성된 모델을 특정 task에 맞게 post-training하고, RL(ReinFlow 등)과 시뮬레이션 기반 학습을 통해 실제 성능을 검증
  • 평가 체계 구축: Closed-loop 평가 프레임워크와 벤치마크를 설계해 모델 개선 사이클을 빠르게 반복할 수 있는 인프라 구축
  • 대규모 학습 인프라 활용: 대규모 GPU 클러스터 환경에서 분산 학습을 설계하고 실행

조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.
우리는 지금, 변화하는 개발 환경 속에서 유연한 사고와 협업을 통해 새로운 가치를 창출하고 프로젝트의 완성도를 높여갈 인재를 찾고 있습니다.
각 분야의 전문성을 바탕으로 크래프톤 전사 프로젝트의 성공을 함께 지원하고 성장하고 싶은 분들의 도전을 기다립니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 담당 게임 및 IP의 시장 환경, 플레이어, 경쟁 구도와 사업 현황을 분석하고 중장기 퍼블리싱 전략과 성장 로드맵을 수립합니다.
  • 신규 게임, 신규 시장, 플랫폼 확장, 외부 개발 및 파트너십 등 새로운 사업 기회를 발굴하고 구체적인 이니셔티브로 발전시킵니다.
  • 신규 이니셔티브의 시장 규모, 전략적 적합성, 예상 수익과 비용, 투자 규모, 실행 가능성 및 주요 리스크를 분석하여 Business Case를 작성하고 우선순위를 제안합니다.
  • 잠재 개발사, 퍼블리셔 및 사업 파트너를 발굴하고, 제안서와 피치 평가, 역량 검증, Due Diligence, 파트너 선정 및 계약 협상을 지원하거나 주도합니다.
  • 파트너십의 역할과 책임, 권리 범위, 사업 구조, 의사결정 체계 및 주요 조건을 설계하고, 합의된 사업이 실제 성과로 이어지도록 실행을 관리합니다.
  • 담당 프로젝트의 개발, 출시 및 라이브 서비스 과정에서 주요 일정, 마일스톤, 의존성, 예산, 품질 기준과 리스크를 관리합니다.
  • 개발 스튜디오와 외부 파트너의 주요 PoC로서 업무 진행 상황과 쟁점을 관리하고, 필요한 의사결정과 후속 실행을 리드합니다.
  • 사업, 마케팅, 커뮤니티, 운영, 플랫폼, 데이터, 재무 및 법무 등 내부 유관 조직과 협업하여 프로젝트의 목표와 실행 방향을 조율합니다.
  • 주요 사업 현황과 의사결정 사항을 구조화하여 경영진 및 이해관계자 대상 보고 자료를 작성하고, 액션 아이템과 프로젝트 성과를 지속적으로 관리합니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 게임 산업 내 게임 퍼블리싱, 사업개발(BD), 사업전략, 프로덕트 또는 프로젝트 관리 분야에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • 다수의 이해관계자가 참여하는 프로젝트에서 일정, 리스크, 의사결정 및 액션 아이템을 체계적으로 관리한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 불확실하고 복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 구체적인 전략과 실행 과제로 전환할 수 있으신 분
  • 글로벌 개발 스튜디오 및 해외 파트너와

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 해외 지사, 외부 파트너와의 커뮤니케이션을 위한 한영/영한 통역 및 관련 자료/이메일 번역
  • 위스퍼링(기기)/동시(부스)/순차/수행 통역
  • 프로젝트 내 문서 번역 및 영어 커뮤니케이션 지원 (영↔한, 한↔영)

  • 통번역대학원 한영과 수료/졸업
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • Zoom, Teams 등 화상 통역 툴 사용 경험
  • 게임 산업 전반에 대한 이해 또는 관심

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.
  • 전형 일정 및 합격 또는 불합격 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일 또는 유선으로 개별 안내 드립니다.

필요 서류를 확인해주세요!

  • 입사지원서 (자유 양식), 자기소개서, 경력기술서, 포트폴리오 (필요 시)
  • 신입일 경우 자기소개서를, 경력일 경우 경력기술서를 중심으로 기술해 주시기 바랍니다.
  • 포트폴리오 첨부 시, 하단 안내 사항을 확인해 주시기 바랍니다.

근무지

  • 역삼 센터필드

    • 정글 교육 과정의 성과 극대화를 위하여 효과적인 캠페인 전략을 기획/실행하며, 타 사례와 정글의 캠페인 결과를 분석하고, 더 효과적인 실행 방안을 도출합니다.
    • 캠페인 정성/정량 데이터를 수집하고, 데이터 기반의 성과 분석 프로세스 및 대시보드 구축을 실행합니다.
    • 교육생 모집 선발, 학사운영 및 입소식, 수료식, 발표회 등 주요 교육 행사와 프로그램의 준비 및 실행, 운영을 지원합니다.
    • 교육과정이 원활하게 운영될 수 있도록 기타 운영 업무 전반을 지원합니다.
  • 이 직무를 통해 이런 경험을 할 수 있습니다.
    • 교육 사업 기반의 캠페인 설계 및 실행, 교육 사업 분야에 대한 전문적 인사이트와 업무 경력을 축적할 수 있습니다.
    • 교육 사업의 브랜드 관리와 마케팅 실행, 사업 및 학사 운영을 아우르는 통합적인 브랜드 육성 경험을 쌓을 수 있습니다.

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 기업(교육, 서비스, IT 계열) 또는 전문 에이전시에서 통합 마케팅 기획/실행의 PM 수행 경력
  • 능동적으로 솔루션을 제시할 수 있는 적극적인 마인드와 긍정적인 에너지
  • 맡은 업무를 꼼꼼하게 확인하고 책임감 있게 마무리할 수 있는 분
  • 다양한 사람들과 원활하게 커뮤니케이션할 수 있는 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

jobs.title: [Palworld Mobile] System Designer (3년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • Palworld Mobile은 원작의 오픈월드 경험을 유지하면서도, 언제 어디서나 빠르게 몰입할 수 있는 게임 플레이를 제공하고자 합니다.
  • 모바일에 최적화된 인터페이스와 터치 기반 조작 시스템을 통해 손안에서 펼쳐지는 무한한 모험의 세계를 즐길 수 있도록 설계하려 합니다.
  • 원작의 방대한 오픈월드와 생존, 제작 시스템, 다양한 Pal과 함께하는 즐거움을 유지하면서도, 모바일 환경에 최적화된 플레이로 만들어 나갈 예정입니다.
  • Palworld Mobile에서만 경험할 수 있는 새로운 기능과 콘텐츠로 진일보된 게임 플레이 경험을 선사하고자 합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 커뮤니티 등의 아웃 게임 시스템 디자인
  • 이벤트 시스템
  • 로그인, CDN, 운영툴 연동 등의 서비스 및 운영에 필요한 기능 기획
  • 업적, 퀘스트, 성장 등 기본 시스템 구현 및 개선 작업

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 최소 3년의 관련 게임 기획 경력
  • 원작 팰월드 플레이 경험이 50 시간 이상인 분
  • 기획 의도를 컨셉화하고 능동적으로 제안하며, 이미지/툴/데이터테이블 등으로 시스템 구조를 구체화하는 능력
  • 다양한 구성원들과 피드백을 주고받으며, 성장을 추구하시는 분
  • 모바일 플랫폼을 고려하여 UI/UX 기획이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 팰월드 뿐만 아니라 러스트, 언던(모바일) 등의 생존 게임을 100 시간 이상 플레이한 경험
  • 이벤트 및 결제 시스템에 대한 업무 경험

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

jobs.title: [PUBG Franchise] Art Director (10년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • PUBG IP를 기반으로 신작 및 transmedia 확장 프로젝트의 비주얼 방향성을 수립하고, IP 전반의 visual foundation을 체계화하며, 내부 및 외부 제작을 전략적으로 리딩하는 조직입니다.
  • 단순 제작 조직이 아니라, IP Visual Core 및 세계관 고도화 / Franchise 확장을 위한 장기적 visual system 구축 / 외부 파트너 및 스튜디오 협업 관리 / 병렬 프로젝트 대응 및 QC 체계 확립을 담당하는 전략 실행 조직입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

PUBG IP Universe의 core visual foundation 및 세계관 고도화를 리딩하며, 동시에 외부 제작 및 병렬 프로젝트 대응을 매니징합니다. 비주얼 기준을 정의하고 문서화하며, 내외부 제작 파트너가 동일한 방향성과 품질 기준으로 실행할 수 있도록 alignment와 QC 체계를 구축하고 운영합니다. 본 포지션은 최종 Art Director의 방향성과 승인 하에 운영되며, IP 기준 생산과 외부 실행 운영 기능을 분담하여 프로젝트 속도와 일관성을 강화합니다.

  • PUBG IP Universe의 core visual boundaries 정의 및 Visual Foundation 고도화
  • IP 확장 프로젝트를 고려한 visual consistency framework 구축 및 중장기 운영 시스템 설계
  • IP Visual 및 가이드 문서의 구조화, 유지보수 체계 수립, 내부 공유 및 적용
  • 외부 스튜디오 및 개인 아티스트 협업 매니징 (본 포지션은 비주얼 기준/프레임워크의 전문적 정의 및 설계와 주요 마일스톤 최종 비주얼 판단을 담당)
  • 병렬 프로젝트 대응을 위한 리뷰 cadence, milestone gate, acceptance criteria 운영 및 리스크 관리
  • Visual drift, rework, 일정 지연, 품질 편차를 조기에 감지하고 대응안을 제시
  • 최종 AD 및 결정권에게 의사결정에 필요한 옵션과 근거를 정리하여 보고하고, 승인 후 실행을 리딩

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 해외 출장 결격사유가 없는 분
  • AAA 또는 동급 규모 프로젝트에서 아트 퀄리티 바를 리딩한 경험 또는 동급 역할을 수행한 경험
  • 스타일 가이드, 기준 문서, 레퍼런스 시스템 등 비주얼 기준을 정의하고 운영한 경험
  • 외부 파트너(스튜디오, 프리랜서)와의 협업에서 브리핑, 피드백, QC를 리딩한 경험

  • 현지 프로팀 발굴·육성 및 커뮤니티·인플루언서 기반 팬덤 확대

  • 대회 일정·예산·성과 지표 관리 및 HQ 리포팅
  • 지역 전략 수립 및 실행 지원

3. 시장 성숙도에 맞는 지역별 우선순위 및 실행 계획 수립

jobs.title: Principal Engineer
jobs.description:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

  • Setting AI up to succeed. You treat context engineering as a craft (the right files, specs, examples and constraints), and you architect systems with clean interfaces, good naming, machine-readable specs and knowledge bases so the codebase is a quality baseline AI can work on later. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
jobs.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked.  We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves.

Desired Experience

You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means

Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale

You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better

You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build

You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects

Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.  The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. In this role, you'll own the  query engine  that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.  This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

Own storage and indexing across backends:  data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

Measure precision and completeness:  end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

You will build the brief, run the launch, and shape how millions of creators understand what is possible today and where we’re headed.

This role is based in our San Mateo, CA Headquarters on a hybrid model, in-person three days a week, and reports into the Director of Creator Product Marketing.

Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Product Catalogs
jobs.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This role is open to candidates based in the UK or the Netherlands.

Our ads team is developing Dynamic Product Ads, enabling us to match users to specific advertiser products. Our vision is for Reddit’s product ads to be highly relevant and contextual. A user browsing r/golf sees ads for popular golf clubs. A user reading a thread on r/buyitforlife about sunglasses sees ads for the exact models being discussed, just a few clicks away from a purchase. To achieve this vision, we need a highly scalable catalog infrastructure and intuitive user experience to onboard thousands of advertisers and ingest millions of products into our systems.

As the Engineering Manager for the Product Catalogs team at Reddit, you will lead the full stack team responsible for our entire advertiser-facing experience. You will build UIs, APIs, and backend systems that manage advertiser’s products. The team also works closely with the knowledge graph teams to power organic shopping. This role combines technical expertise, leadership abilities, and drive to understand and deliver on customer needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Create a world class catalogs system that can scale to support billions of products
  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of experience in backend or full stack product development</

jobs.title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

What You'll Do

Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.
  • Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
  • Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.
  • Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
  • Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
  • Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
  • Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
  • Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
  • Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
  • Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
  • Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.

Local Day Two Operations Readiness

  • Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest

YouTube

channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.  And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

Changing your car should feel like one seamless journey, not a series of disconnected tasks. Right now it's the opposite: people value their car in one place, search for the next one in another, and manage the handover somewhere else, much of it on the web and most of it forgotten between car changes. The Carwow app is our most direct relationship with those customers, and today it is nowhere near what it could be.

We are reimagining it. If we can give people a reason to open Carwow between car changes, understand what they drive and what they want next, and make the moment of changing effortless, the app becomes the place UK drivers start. This role is the product voice at the table for that: setting the direction for what we build and working day to day with design and engineering to build it.

This is also a moment where AI changes what's possible. The best consumer apps of the next few years won't be lists with filters; they will understand you and act on your behalf. We want to build those things. The PM in this role will need the curiosity to explore what that could look like, the fluency to prototype it quickly with the latest tools, and the rigour to distinguish genuine value from noise.

If you want to shape a new consumer product from the ground up, work at the cutting edge of applied AI, and build things that millions of UK drivers could use, this is it.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Product Strategy & Execution:

Set the product direction for the Carwow consumer app, defining what we build, in what order, and why

Lead discovery work with consumers: interviews, usage data, behavioural analysis, to build a precise understanding of where the app can add the most value

Identify, prototype and ship opportunities to bring AI into the app: smarter discovery, personalisation and recommendations that actually change behaviour

Collaborate with the Engineering Manager, Designer and Engineers as a product trio to ship well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics

Manage the backlog with commercial awareness, prioritising work that drives engagement, retention and revenue, not just activity

Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. The Role

You will report directly to the VP, Vendor Procurement and work day to day with the Regional Procurement Directors and Category Managers in EMEA and AMER, taking agreements from first draft through to signature, from MNDAs and MSAs to frameworks.  You will work from Volta's approved templates, negotiation playbooks and fallback positions, and escalate non-standard legal risk to the VP Vendor Procurement/Legal team and/or external counsel rather than determining it yourself. As Head of Operations you own Lyceum's GPU fleet end to end: every GPU we own, lease or operate for partners, from the first conversation with a data center to the day a node goes live and every day it runs after that.  The job has two halves. Grow the fleet: turn new financing into live GPUs, fast. Run the fleet: keep everything we operate available, efficient and under contract. Your north star is GPUs under management. You report directly to the CEO and work closely with the CFO, CTO and engineering. Depending on experience, we hire this role at Head or VP level.

What You'll Do

Secure data center capacity across Europe: power, liquid cooling, space, connectivity and colocation leases

Own relationships with OEMs and suppliers for servers, networking and storage, and manage lead times so hardware arrives when we need it

Run every deployment as a programme, from logistics and installation to burn-in, acceptance and handover to engineering

Keep the financing side of deployments clean: schedules, drawdown milestones, asset records, insurance and lender reporting

Run the live fleet together with engineering: availability, incidents, RMAs, warranty, spares and remote hands

Own supply-side contracts, renewals and SLAs, and drive down cost per GPU-hour

Build the operations team and the operating rhythm that lets us scale deployments without scaling chaos

Your profile

What We're Looking For

A track record of bringing physical infrastructure online at scale, ideally data centers, GPU or HPC clusters, or comparable hardware-heavy environments

You have owned the whole picture, from capacity and suppliers to deployment and live operations, not one slice of it

Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking. You see the whole board, from site selection to unit economics

Enough technical depth to hold your own with engineers and vendors on power, cooling, networking and hardware

Strong programme management: you run complex projects with many parties against hard deadlines

Confidence negotiating and managing contracts with data centers, OEMs and suppliers

You have built and led teams from scratch and still go deep into the details yourself

Very high sense of urgency and ownership

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis,  you must reside and have the legal right to work  in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis.

We do not partner with search firms.

About

We're looking for a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to join our Engineering team and help build and improve the products and systems behind Lokalise. You'll work closely with Product, Design, other engineers, and stakeholders to identify and solve meaningful customer problems, improve existing experiences, and shape what we build next.

Each of our engineering teams owns a product domain at Lokalise, from vision to delivery. Teams talk to customers, uncover their pains and needs, define their own goals, and choose how to solve the problems that matter most.  We're hiring across multiple domains , so you'll own a real piece of the product and see your impact firsthand.

We're building an  AI-native engineering culture  where engineers take ownership of problems, not just implementation.  We expect you to question assumptions, challenge decisions, contribute to product direction, and find better ways to solve customer problems.

You'll use AI throughout the development process to move faster without compromising quality. Your responsibility doesn't end when code reaches production. You'll care about whether what we built actually works, delivers value, and solves the problem we set out to address.

You Will

Own problems end to end, from discovery and design to production and iteration. You take initiative instead of waiting to be told.

Build, test, and maintain features across the stack, with clean, scalable, and maintainable code.

Build modern applications with  React, TanStack Router, and modular-react  on the frontend, and  Node.js, Fastify, Drizzle  on the backend.

Work in a Dockerized TypeScript environment with  Vitest and Playwright  for testing.

Partner with Product and Design to shape what we build, focusing on

jobs.title: Principal Researcher
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

DoorDash's mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. At DoorDash, there are three audiences that are at the core of every decision we make - our Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers. The Research team has a direct link to uncover the unmet needs and pain points of each of these audiences. We bring their voices into the business in order to help set the strategic vision for all of DoorDash's current and future products.

About the Role

We're looking for a  Principal Researcher  to be a strategic research leader for EMEA, shaping what DoorDash builds next. You'll combine deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative methods to find the unmet needs, behavioral shifts, and market openings that point to new products and new growth. You'll work as a peer to senior product, design, engineering, data science, and business leaders, and your work will directly inform roadmaps, investment decisions, and company-level strategy.

This role is built for a seasoned researcher who is equally comfortable in a living room interview, a survey dataset, and a leadership review, and who uses AI as a daily tool to move faster and see further, without giving up the judgment that makes research trustworthy. You'll also raise the bar for the wider research practice by mentoring researchers, sharing methods, and helping the team define what great looks like in an AI-enabled era.

What You'll Be Doing

Shape Product Strategy:  Translate deep understanding of Consumers, Merchants, and Couriers into a clear point of view on where DoorDash should play and win. You'll frame the highest-stakes questions, bring evidence to roadmap and investment debates, and influence decisions at the director and executive level.

Detect New Opportunities:  Proactively identify emerging needs, behavior changes, and white space that point to new products, new verticals, and new growth levers. You'll size and validate opportunities with a mix of foundational discovery, market and competitive context, and behavioral data, and turn them into concepts teams can act on.

Lead Mixed-Methods Research:  Design and run rigorous research end to end, choosing the right method for the question: ethnography, in-depth interviews, diary studies, and usability testing alongside surveys, conjoint and MaxDiff, segmentation, experiment design, and behavioral and log analysis. You'll triangulate across sources so the "what," the "how much," and the "why" tell one coherent story.

jobs.title: Robotics Test Automation Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Role

You will develop software for system and regression testing of our robots, including test scripts, test tools, and automation solutions. Your core output will be high-quality, reusable test software that helps the team improve the efficiency, coverage, and repeatability of robot system testing.

This is a development engineer role. You will collaborate with the robotics test and system test engineers in the team to develop scripts, tools, and automation solutions for key software and hardware test scenarios across our robot systems.

In addition to software development, you will have the opportunity to participate directly in validation and debugging work on physical robots and in simulation environments. You will run and refine the tools and automated test solutions you develop on real systems, gaining first-hand insight into how robots behave and the challenges they face in real-world environments.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop system, integration, and regression test scripts in Python or C++ for various robotic platforms
  • Develop ROS 2-based test tools, such as nodes for stimulating and monitoring the system, tools for data recording and replay, log and rosbag analysis, and test result reporting
  • Debug, validate, run, and maintain automated test solutions in simulation environments and on physical robots
  • Develop scripts and tools for long-duration stability, performance, and fault-injection testing
  • Work with system test engineers in the team to turn manual test scenarios suitable for automation into stable, reusable test scripts
  • Integrate test scripts into CI/CD pipelines so that they run automatically with each build
  • Maintain test code quality through code reviews, documentation, and version control
  • Use the tools you develop to support issue reproduction, diagnosis, and analysis

What You Bring

  • Hands-on ROS 2 development experience gained through work, internships, a thesis, or student projects; able to write nodes using rclpy or rclcpp, with familiarity in topics, services, actions, parameters, launch files, and rosbag
  • A robotics background, with practical experience in robot development or testing through work, internships, a working student role, a thesis, or student projects
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Python or C++
  • A Bachelor’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field; recent graduates are welcome
  • Familiarity with Linux and Git
  • A long-term interest in robot testing and quality engineering, as well as an interest in debugging and validating your own code on real robots
  • Good written and spoken English skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robot arms, legged robots, or other mobile robot platfor

WHAT IS BOX?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

We need strong sellers to help new customers realise their digital transformation goals while evolving how our current customer base leverages Box. By joining the Box Enterprise Sales team you will have an opportunity to work alongside our most senior sales leaders and our largest customer base.

  • Collaborate with internal partners to move deals forward and ensure customer success

  • Demonstrated adaptability in learning about new technology and products

  • Have clear examples of closing complex deals and your sales process

  • Effectively uses a repeatable method for uncovering greenfield opportunities and building

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Proven experience building and scaling large-scale infrastructure systems

Strong hands-on engineering background; ability to code and design systems

Experience scaling infrastructure across regions

Experience using AI tooling platforms (Claude Code)

Experience leading managers and scaling to multi-team structures

jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re

Checkout.com

. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role overview

Complex merchants can create complex financial crime risks. Their corporate structures, operating models and control environments may span entities, jurisdictions and teams. When concerns emerge, effective action depends on more than identifying the issue: someone must bring the right people together, agree a credible response, and keep remediation moving until it is complete.

As Financial Crime Oversight & Remediation Manager, you will provide that ownership. You will coordinate targeted oversight of higher-risk or strategically important merchant relationships, helping turn concerns into clear, proportionate and evidenced plans. You will work across Compliance, Financial Crime Investigations, onboarding, commercial and operational teams, and, where appropriate, directly with merchants. Your judgement will matter: you will need to know when a proposed control or remediation is credible, when evidence is insufficient, and when an issue needs escalation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines financial crime compliance expertise with strong delivery discipline. You will help address issues early, support defensible decisions, and give complex remediation the structure and follow-through it needs.

What you’ll do

Own targeted remediation coordination.  For complex merchant concerns, bring together the relevant internal teams, clarify the problem and desired outcomes, agree accountable owners and milestones, and maintain a practical plan through to closure. Track dependencies and slippage, challenge gaps, escalate material blockers and confirm that completion is supported by evidence.

Coordinate Compliance-imposed conditions.  Track material financial-crime conditions attached to product, market or other approval decisions. Work with the relevant Compliance and business owners to confirm accountability, milestones and evidence of completion; identify slippage or gaps; challenge whether evidence demonstrates the condition has been met; and escalate overdue or inadequately evidenced actions

About the Role

Together AI is looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build and scale our account-based field and in-person community programs across priority markets.

This role will be responsible for developing the strategy, audience, format, and execution of high-impact field programs designed to engage priority accounts, accelerate pipeline, deepen customer relationships, and build authentic technical community.

You’ll own programs end-to-end, from identifying the right accounts and developing the event concept to driving attendance, managing the attendee experience, partnering with Sales on follow-up, and measuring business impact.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who can pair strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You should be just as comfortable building an ABM event strategy with Sales as you are selecting a venue, shaping an agenda, managing a vendor, or reviewing the attendee list the day before an event.

Responsibilities

ABM & Account-Based Events

  • Develop and execute an ABM event strategy aligned to priority segments, accounts, pipeline goals, and sales priorities.
  • Develop repeatable account-based field programs for priority accounts and segments, including dinners, roundtables, customer gatherings, and other targeted regional programs.
  • Partner closely with Sales to identify the right accounts, stakeholders, and moments in the buying cycle for each program.
  • Own account targeting, invitation strategy, registration goals, attendance conversion, and post-event follow-up plans.
  • Ensure every program has a clear business objective and defined next step for participating accounts.
  • Evaluate program performance based on account engagement, pipeline creation and acceleration, POCs, opportunities, and other meaningful business outcomes.

Community Programs

  • Build and scale Together AI’s community event strategy across key markets.
  • Develop meetups, technical gatherings, workshops, partner programs, and other formats that bring together developers, researchers, AI practitioners, customers, and ecosystem partners.
  • Partner with DevRel, Research, Product, Engineering, and other technical teams to develop programming that is genuinely useful and relevant to the audience.
  • Identify opportunities to partner with customers, investors, technology partners, startups, and community organizations to extend reach and credibility.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. About the role

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist with deep expertise in antibody process development and manufacturing to join the team.   • Communicate findings clearly to biology, AI research, and life sciences audiences

jobs.title: Fullstack Entwickler mit PHP-Backend – Symfony, RabbitMQ (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

Rockstardevelopers, gegründet 2015 in Mannheim, weitere Büros in Stuttgart und München. Wir sind ein Software-Entwickler mit Erfahrung aus hunderten von individuellen Projekten für Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden.

Kurze Wege, ehrliches Feedback, keine politischen Spielchen. Keine Hierarchie-Ebenen zwischen dir und den Leuten, die Entscheidungen treffen.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest in Kundenprojekten bei großen Unternehmen, eingebettet in deren Teams. Dein Schwerpunkt ist das Backend: Schnittstellen, Datenflüsse zwischen Systemen und die Logik dahinter. Im Frontend packst du mit an, wenn es das Feature braucht.

Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP, bevorzugt Symfony

REST-APIs entwerfen und mit OpenAPI dokumentieren

Systeme über Messaging verbinden: RabbitMQ, Symfony Messenger oder Kafka

GitLab-Pipelines aufbauen und pflegen, vom Build bis zum Deployment

Code generieren, reviewen und refactoren mit Claude Code, Copilot oder Cursor

Abstimmung mit Product Ownern, Frontend und Betrieb

Die Einsätze laufen überwiegend remote. Beim Kunden bist du an einzelnen Präsenztagen, zum Beispiel in Berlin an zwei bis drei Tagen im Monat. Wer mag, kommt zusätzlich in eins unserer Büros. Zwang ist das keiner.

Wo du landest

Je nach Projekt bei Großkonzernen, im öffentlichen Sektor oder bei Enterprise- und Mittelstands-Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen. Unsere Kunden besetzen diese Projekte fast nur mit Festangestellten. Deshalb suchen wir dich in Festanstellung.

Was du mitbringst

Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwickler, gezählt nach Ausbildung oder Studium.

Das erwarten wir:

PHP, mindestens drei Jahre produktiv in den letzten fünf Jahren, bevorzugt mit Symfony (Laravel ist auch in Ordnung)

REST-API-Design einschließlich OpenAPI

CI/CD mit GitLab-Pipelines

Message-basierte Architektur mit RabbitMQ oder Vergleichbarem (Symfony Messenger auf AMQP, Kafka)

Automatisierte Tests mit PHPUnit, dazu Integrations- und End-to-End-Tests

Von Vorteil (kein Muss):

LLM-Integration in Anwendungen (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agenten), auch aus einem Nebenprojekt

Pimcore 11 oder ein anderes CMS

Datenmodellierung mit MariaDB oder MySQL

TypeScript mit Vue oder React

AWS

Echtzeit-Schnittstellen und Datenpipelines

Du musst nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass du im PHP-Backend sicher bist und dich schnell in neue Stacks reinfindest.

Projektsprache ist Deutsch

Du arbeitest im Team des Kunden, auf Deutsch, in Meetings und in der Dokumentation. Wir erwarten Deutsch auf C1-Niveau oder besser.

AI-Tools sind Pflicht, kein Bonus

Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor: Damit musst du produktiv arbeiten können. Unsere Kunden erwarten das, und wir arbeiten auch so. Intern investieren wir in deine AI-Skills.

Was wir bieten

Überwiegend remote, dazu Büro, wenn du magst

MacBook (außer der Kunde stellt eigene Hardware)

Verschiedene Kunden, verschiedene Projekte

Die Gründer sind deine direkten Ansprechpartner

Internes Upskilling in AI-Entwicklung

Bewerbung

You start in the region between Paris and Strasbourg and spend the first months in the field yourself: you meet dealers, sign the first customers, and see their first cars sell at auction. Then you hire a team of up to six and take it nationwide.

CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform, and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet.

Technical ownership end to end:  You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale.

Build where building unblocks:  Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick.

AI where it meets the customer:  You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers, including the auth and data boundaries that have to hold around them.

Technical authority in the account:  You work with customer project management, IT, security, functional departments and works councils, you decide the technical questions, and you feed the gaps you see back into our product and engineering teams. Join SE3 Labs as a UI/UX Software Engineer

Design and build intuitive, high-performance interfaces for autonomous systems, turning complex operational capabilities into software that people can use confidently in the real world.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.  We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our future, help us build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.  Our founding team’s research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field

About the Role

As a UI/UX Software Engineer at SE3 Labs, you’ll take ownership of how our software looks, feels and performs. Your core challenge is to build one coherent interface system that works across many contexts: different devices, screen sizes, plugins and product features, from large command displays to small field devices with limited computing power. You’ll combine UX/UI design with hands-on front-end development, working closely with our software team. From integrating 3D visualisations to building interfaces for military personnel in the field, you’ll help shape a product from the ground up and see the direct impact of your work.

jobs.title: Safety Research Scholar - Human Frontier Labs
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

That work includes finding where models fail, checking whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Scholars take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Each scholar owns a substantial part of a safety research project. You'll work alongside a mentor from the research question through the experiments to deciding what to test next.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide Research Scholars on projects in selected AI safety research areas in select AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AIs, including detecting harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment auditing and evaluations: Building scalable methods to test whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks and evaluations: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: 728 task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: simulating real-world pressure to choose between safe or harmful behavior
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.

▪ Industry: Deep-tech / Active Muon Imaging & Laser-Plasma Accelerators

▪ HQ & Locations: Hamburg (DE) – HQ; Tallinn (EE)

▪ Size:  1–10 employees

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.  Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operat

jobs.title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
jobs.description:
HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen.  Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform.

Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.  Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt.  Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen.

Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren.

Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung?  Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform.  Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann.  Die Position ist auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit in Teilzeit mit etwa 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt. Über das konkrete Arbeitsmodell sprechen wir gerne individuell.  Aufgaben

Interaction & Workflow Design:  Du entwickelst intuitive Interaktionskonzepte für komplexe industrielle Softwareanwendungen und optimierst die Abläufe zwischen Informationen, Entscheidungen und Aktionen.

User Journey & Task Flow Design:  Du analysierst, wie unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen ihre täglichen Aufgaben erledigen, und entwickelst daraus effiziente, verständliche und möglichst reibungslose Bedienabläufe.

Information Architecture & Navigation:  Du konzipierst die Informationsstruktur und Navigation unserer Anwendungen. Nutzer sollen relevante Informationen und Funktionen schnell, intuitiv und ohne unnötige Schritte erreichen.

User Research & Prozessanalyse:  Du verstehst die Arbeitsrealität von Maschinenbedienern, Schichtleitern, Instandhaltern und Produktionsmanagern und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete UX Konzepte.

Komplexität reduzieren:  Du hinterfragst bestehende Workflows

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer for one or more security domains end to end: design the controls, build the systems that enforce and verify them, and set the technical standard the rest of the team and our partners build to.

The engineering is in the controls and the tooling that proves them. The goal is security that runs itself: requirements kept as code and checked automatically, evidence, chain of custody and access continuously verified, and tools and agents in place of manual reviews. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

This is a foundational role: you'll shape how our security engineering is built and scaled. The team's physical security systems engineers design and test the site security systems themselves; this role engineers the controls around them and across the domains beyond the facility itself: hardware custody, media, personnel and vendors. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, Anthropic's compute, data center operations, legal, compliance and procurement teams, and directly with data center operators, hardware vendors and logistics providers.

The role involves regular travel to data center sites, which are critical infrastructure, and may include on-call for security events at them.

Key responsibilities

  • Security domains, end to end: own one or more of physical security at partner-operated and Anthropic-operated sites, hardware supply chain and chain of custody, media protection and sanitization, personnel security and site access, third-party and vendor security assessment, and maintenance and contingency controls
  • Tools, automation and AI agents: build the internal tools, automation and agents the team runs on: evidence collection, access reviews, asset and custody tracking, partner intake. When a process keeps costing people time, you build the tool that retires it
  • Security review for new sites, leases and vendors: find the gaps in the design, the contract and the operator's procedures, write the security terms and exhibits, and verify the fixes after signing

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description:
Hi!  I'm  Chris , head of Product Design at  Ashby .

We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on.

Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet.

How We Work

In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers.

We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager.

This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean.

Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CEO. Both Abhik and Benji (our founders) care deeply about design, which at first glance may seem counterintuitive given the number of full-time designers that we employ. The belief is not that design is unimportant, but rather that it should be owned by the product team collectively, not solely by a group of full-time designers who happen to have the job title.

The design

department’s

job at Ashby is not to make every single design decision but to equip our entire product team to make better decisions themselves, as well as edit decisions that PMs/Engineers choose to make. That, while tackling the biggest design challenges ourselves.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Life Sciences team, you'll build biology software that our own scientists and the wider research community can depend on, and you'll be one of the main people representing that work to computational biologists outside Anthropic.

The Life Sciences team works to accelerate progress in biology with AI, combining frontier models with hands-on computational and experimental research. We want the tools, pipelines, datasets, and benchmarks we build in genomics and structural biology to be useful beyond our own projects, so we plan to release them to the community. Computational biology has a long tradition of open, shared software, and we want to contribute to it well. Every release should be something a researcher can install, run on their own data, and trust: correct on real inputs, validated against reference data and established methods, documented, versioned, and maintained after launch.

You'll own that standard. You'll write a large share of the code yourself, decide when something is ready to ship, and stay with it once people start using it. You'll also be an active member of the biology software community: maintaining public repositories, answering issues, speaking at conferences and workshops, and bringing what you hear from researchers back into what we build next.

We use Claude and AI coding agents heavily to build software, and we expect you to do the same across design, implementation, testing, and review. Code written by an agent is held to the same standard as code written by hand: you should understand it, test it, and measure its performance before it ships. We're looking for someone with deep software engineering experience who already works this way.

The shape of the role is flexible. You might spend most of your time as an individual contributor, or you might lead a small group of engineers and scientists while continuing to contribute directly. Your focus can be genomics, structural biology, or both. Experience in other areas of computational biology is welcome, and we expect the work to range more widely over time.

What matters most is a record of biology software that other people have adopted and relied on.

This is a chance to shape how AI is put to work in biological research, on problems that matter for human health and scientific understanding. If building software that scientists trust is the work you want to do, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine  cutting-edge biology  and  AI  to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world’s largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our  AI-powered predictive engine , helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.  Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to  bring more effective treatments to patients  who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a  fast-growing, mission-driven startup  at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

We are looking for a curious engineering mind to lead the scaling of Orakl’s omics data within the Computational Biology team.  Every organoid grown in our lab is sequenced (WGS and RNA-seq). Our pipelines turn the raw reads into processed molecular profiles, and our models turn those profiles into clinical trial predictions, patient segments and new target candidates. Your mission will be to make omics data available to computational biologists and research engineers in a form they can build on. You will gather their needs and, in coordination with the Data & Infra team, design the data representations, storage layouts and access patterns that make model training and experimentation fast and reproducible. As our biobank expands, this will become a massive omics corpus that must efficiently serve client contracts, strategic partnerships and internal R&D projects.  Starting from processed omics data, you will assess how it is stored and served today, propose solutions to scale it, and drive their implementation, so our scientists and models can rely on it. You will build this hand in hand with our data engineering team, keeping our omics infrastructure consistent with the rest of the company’s stack. You will report to the Head of Computational Biology.  Experience with omics data is a strong plus, not a prerequisite. If you come from the conventional tabular data world and want to master data that is massive, multi-layered and regularly reprocessed, this role is built for you.

What you will do

Design and build the omics data architecture.  Together with our data engineering team, define and evolve how omics data is stored as the corpus grows: what lives in a database, what stays in columnar files on S3, and how it all fits the company’s stack.

Guarantee reliable ingestion.  Make sure every new batch of processed omics data (variant calls, expression, CNV, QC metrics, sample and sequencing tracking) lands reliably and consistently with our da

Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.  This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

Architecture:  write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

Scale livestreaming:  architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

Own the fleet:  reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

Gate production changes:  define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

Take the final escalation:  handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

Raise the bar:  mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - UK
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  ,  Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

Vanwege het vertrek van de huidige plaatsvervangend CPO is tijdelijke versterking nodig om de continuïteit van de privacyorganisatie te waarborgen. Op termijn wordt de functie structureel ingevuld. In deze opdracht ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verder inrichten en uitbouwen van de CPO-functie, het versterken van de privacy governance en het adviseren van management bij complexe privacyvraagstukken.
